scope: Controlled graphical host and directly tested local presentation/storage components, not a complete Atoll fork. No DynamicNotch source has been copied into this host.

files.modifications: Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Read-only IOKit power-source adapter: copies the power-source list and returns the internal battery; IOPSNotificationCreateRunLoopSource on the main run loop only while enabled, removed and invalidated on stop. No permission, entitlement or network use.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. In-memory internal-battery reading parsed from IOKit power-source descriptions (rejects other sources and implausible values), notice rules (plug in/out, low at 20% and 10% once per crossing, charged including optimized-charging stops; first reading after start is quiet) and the injected-environment BatteryController lifecycle (single observation, stop forgets readings).

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Read-only EventKit adapter: full-access status/request, calendars and events for visible calendars only (bounded to 500), store created only while enabled; observes EKEventStoreChanged, day change, time-zone change and wake; one-shot timer to the next boundary; opens events in Calendar via ical:// and validated meeting links on explicit action. Notes/location read only in memory for meeting-link detection.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. In-memory agenda model (today with all-day first, next timed event, local-day boundaries, next refresh at the soonest boundary or midnight, https-only known-host meeting links, cleaned titles) and the injected-environment CalendarController lifecycle (access states, single access request, hidden calendars never read, generation-guarded timers, stop clears everything). Upcoming event on a later day (timed or all-day) within a 30-day lookahead, and natural day labels.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Injected-environment capture lifecycle: one capture at a time, permission gating without hiding islands, hide/restore exactly once on success, cancel and failure, error classification without image contents. Window/display capture (0.4.0): selection returns a CaptureTarget (region or window) passed through to capture.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Pure region-selection math: drag normalization, clamping to the starting display, minimum size, AppKit-to-Core-Graphics global coordinate conversion. Inverse Core Graphics-to-AppKit rect and point conversions for window highlighting and hit-testing.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. NSPasteboard adapter: change count and type list read without the paste alert, accessBehavior mapped to the access states, contents read only after the skip check (file URLs, PNG/TIFF with pixel size, text), writing back by type, frontmost app name excluding itself, half-second polling only while enabled, and ImageIO thumbnails.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Memory-only clipboard history model: concealed/transient/password-manager type markers, link detection limited to http(s), bounded items (50), text (100,000 characters), images (20 MB each, 150 MB total, oldest dropped first) and file URLs, duplicates moved to the top, accent-insensitive search and previews; and the injected-environment ClipboardController that records only copies made after starting, never reads while paused or when macOS would ask or deny (and never catches up later), does not record its own copy-back, and forgets everything on stop. Display text for the opened view (line breaks kept, cut for display only at 20,000 characters) and size descriptions.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Carbon RegisterEventHotKey wrapper for the Control-Shift-4 capture shortcut; receives only its own combination, no Accessibility or Input Monitoring permission; explicit register/unregister.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Incoming-call indicator model: caller first name taken only from a plain name in the banner description (numbers and service labels give none; bounded, control characters removed), and the injected-environment IncomingCallController that asks for Accessibility once, re-checks for permission later, observes Notification Center only while trusted, checks every second while ringing and every five otherwise, and on stop unobserves, cancels checks and ignores late events.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Accessibility watcher for macOS's own incoming-call banner (identifier FACETIME_NOTIFICATION, found with a temporary diagnostic probe on macOS 27): AXObserver on Notification Center window changes, re-attached if it restarts, bounded search for the banner, and its description read only for display. Nothing is clicked, logged, stored or sent.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Propagate hover preference changes to existing display presenters immediately. M2 capture increment (0.2.0): capture shortcut lifecycle tied to start/stop and its setting; capture flow wiring, island hide/restore, peek after capture, Copy/Remove/Clear, thumbnails, status messages, and export cleanup at launch and every 30 minutes while running. Drag-out increment (0.3.0): selection state, drag flow wiring to ShelfStore.beginFileDrag/endDrag, shelf hold across presenters, export-capacity messages. Wire capture targets. M3 Spotify increment (0.5.0): persisted settings, Spotify feature switch starting/stopping the controller, Media/Shelf tab, explicit Open Spotify and Automation settings actions, refresh on expansion. M3 Calendar (0.6.0): Calendar switch and hidden calendars persisted, controller start/stop, Calendar tab with fallback when a feature is turned off, access/settings/open/join actions. Publishes the upcoming event. M4 battery (0.7.0): battery switch and alert choices persisted, controller start/stop with the app and switch, notices sent to every visible island except during capture. 0.7.1: album-artwork switch persisted; loader follows the current track only while Spotify and artwork are on and stops with either. Timers (0.8.0): Timers switch, sound and notch choices persisted; controller with main-run-loop wake-ups; wake observer only while enabled; live state applied to all presenters (including new ones); finish plays a sound and shows a notice; turning off or stopping cancels all timers. Stopwatch actions and published state; a running stopwatch keeps the island widened. System activity (0.9.0): switch persisted; sampling runs only while the Stats tab is visible in an open island, re-evaluated on tab change, expansion, display changes and stop. Clipboard history (0.10.0): switch persisted, controller start/stop with the app and switch, thumbnails decoded once per image item, copy-back/remove/clear/pause actions, and opening the pasteboard privacy settings. Downloads and AirDrop (0.11.0): switch persisted, controller start/stop, finished notices, and live notch state shared with timers (transfers first). AirDrop only. Open at login (0.12.0): login-item state read from macOS when Settings opens, changed only by the Settings switch. Temporary incoming-call probe switch (not remembered). Incoming calls (0.14.0): switch persisted, controller start/stop, ringing notice shown on every island and ended when the call stops; temporary probe removed. Ringing calls use the sticky notice so they return after the island is opened and closed.

Adapted getClosedNotchSize measurement ideas into pure display inputs and screen-relative layout; added external floating capsule placement and size bounds. Test-driven fix: preserve menu-bar clearance by bounding panel height below its top edge; compress margins on synthetic tiny frames. Menu-bar clearance: place both complete window rectangles below the maximum safe-area, visible-frame and explicit menu-height band; bound compact/expanded bodies to usable space, and reject unusable geometry. Camera width is metadata, not a content spacer. Notch-sized placement (0.1.3): replaces the below-menu-band placement, which covered application content. On notched displays the compact window equals the public camera-housing rectangle at the top edge, which holds no menus or status items; implausible housing metadata falls back to a bounded width. Non-notched displays use a small pill inset inside the menu-bar center. Only the user-opened expanded state extends across the menu row; expanded content starts below the housing. Battery activity (0.7.0): activity size widening the compact island by equal wings beside the camera housing (or a longer pill), same height, bounded to the display. 0.13.0: size per state and the animatedFrames rule (grow now, settle exactly later; straight to the target without animation or across displays). Open island width 460 so every section icon, the battery and the buttons fit.

files.modifications: Adapted nonactivating panel configuration; replaced upstream managers with per-display presenter and shared local coordinator; removed capture/defaults registration and global services. Extracted original local presentation state into separately tested IslandPresentation.swift. Hover responsiveness: one stable native tracking host per panel, reconcile the actual cursor after events/show/resize, stop tracking before hide/close, and apply preference changes immediately. Refresh public screen/status-bar geometry on show/update/expansion and hide an unusable layout before activating native tracking; menu-row pixels contain no island window. Notch placement (0.1.3): panel level above status items so an open island draws over the menu row; explicit mouse-event receipt for the visually empty notch target; pointer reconciliation includes the display's top edge. Peek entry point for post-capture acknowledgement. Hold entry point that reconciles the pointer before release. Expansion notifies the coordinator (shelf preparation and Spotify refresh). Battery activity (0.7.0): resize to the activity frame while a notice shows; showActivity only on visible, tracking panels. 0.8.0: setLive and frame from the widened state. 0.9.0: reports every expansion change to the coordinator and exposes whether it is open. 0.13.0: the window grows at once and shrinks to the exact frame only after the closing animation settles (a pending shrink is cancelled by any newer change); hover follows the island's visible frame and also reconciles on pointer moves inside the window. endCallNotice ends only a call notice. setStickyNotice replaces endCallNotice.

files.modifications: Extracted locally written presentation state from panel controller; injectable cancellable delay scheduler and stale-callback guard for deterministic race tests. Hover responsiveness: deduplicate unchanged pointer/preference inputs; use 80ms entry and 120ms exit waits; immediately cancel disabled hover work and reset hidden presenters. Peek state: opens briefly, held while the pointer is on it regardless of hover setting, closes after pointer exit, never disturbs an open shelf. Hold state for outgoing drags: pointer exit and hover changes deferred while held, re-evaluated on release; reset on suspend. Battery activity (0.7.0): short notice state with its own stale-guarded timer; ignored while open, ended by opening, peeking, hover-opening or suspension. 0.8.0: notices generalized to battery or timer done (timer notices last 8 s); live state keeps the compact island widened for a running timer, resizing only when the widened state changes. Transfer-done notice (4 s). Transfer notice replaced by AirDrop received. Incoming-call notice, ended explicitly (90-second safety limit). Sticky notice for ongoing events: hidden while the island is open or another notice shows, restored when it closes or that notice ends, removed when cleared.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Remembered on/off settings as one bounded JSON value in the app's own preferences; tolerant per-field decoding; injectable storage. No personal content stored. Calendar switch and bounded, de-duplicated hidden calendar identifiers. Battery switch and alert choices. Album-artwork switch (off by default). Timers switch, sound and notch choices. System activity switch. Clipboard history switch (off by default). Downloads and AirDrop switch. Incoming calls switch.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. App-owned countdown timers (Apple's Clock timers are not observed): pause keeps remaining time, clock and length text, up to five timers with bounded lengths, and the injected-environment TimerController with one generation-guarded wake-up at the earliest end, reconcile for overdue timers after sleep, featured timer for the notch, and stop cancelling everything. Memory only. Stopwatch: start/pause/resume, laps as splits (bounded to 99, no zero-length or paused laps), tenths text that never runs ahead; held by TimerController and reset by stop.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Native presenter owns hover events; SwiftUI content animation shortened to 120ms, respecting Reduce Motion. Move compact tray/Shelf/count content below the system menu band and remove camera-gap and extra notch-height content padding. Notch placement (0.1.3): compact notch state draws no visible content; non-notched compact state is a tray/count pill; expanded content is inset below the camera housing. Shelf tiles with thumbnails, time, Copy/Remove; Capture and Clear header buttons; status message line. Tile drag overlay, selection highlight and selected accessibility trait. Capture button and empty-state text describe region, window and screen capture. Media/Shelf tabs and Media content: track, extrapolated progress via TimelineView, controls, and explicit states for not running, permission needed/denied and no track. Draggable playback scrubber with keyboard/VoiceOver adjust; play/pause symbol swaps without animation; progress view no longer rebuilt on play-state changes. Media/Calendar/Shelf tabs from available features; Calendar content with next event, today's agenda, Join for validated meeting links and explicit access states. Calendar tab always shows a Today section ("No events" when empty) and, once today has nothing left, a Next event section with its day. Battery activity wings (icon left, percentage right, center clear for the camera) and battery level with time estimate in the open island header. 0.7.1: battery glyph fills its whole outline and is colored (green plugged in; green/yellow/orange/red by level on battery), bolt contrasts with the fill; optional album cover beside the track with a placeholder. Timers (0.8.0): shared wing layout for notices; timer-done notice with bell; live countdown with progress ring beside the notch; Timers tab with rows (pause/resume/cancel), presets and a custom length; only the selected tab is labeled when there are more than three. Stopwatch: Timers/Stopwatch switch in the Timers tab, elapsed time with tenths, Start/Pause/Resume, Lap/Reset, laps with fastest and slowest marked; running stopwatch counts up beside the notch when no timer is showing. System activity (0.9.0): Stats tab with CPU, GPU, memory, network, disk and storage tiles, each with a minute-long graph; unavailable readings shown as a dash. Clipboard history (0.10.0): Clipboard tab with search, pause/resume, clear, rows (thumbnail or kind icon, one-line preview, source app and time, remove) that copy again on click, and a notice when macOS asks before each read; tighter tab padding with more than four tabs. Section tabs are icon-only (names on hover and to VoiceOver) with counts kept; the header battery percentage never wraps. Header battery shows the percentage inside the battery like the menu bar (dark over the fill, light over the empty part, bolt while charging), replacing the separate text. Clipboard rows open the item on click and copy with a separate button; opened view shows selectable full text (up to 20,000 characters), a larger image, the whole link or file paths, with Copy, Remove and Back. Downloads and AirDrop (0.11.0): transfer ring and percentage (or file count) beside the notch, Done/Received notice, and a Transfers tab with progress, size, speed, time left, Cancel, Show in Finder and Clear finished. Transfers narrowed to AirDrop: AirDrop tab, icon and Received notice. Media hint names the actual problem: permission needed, denied, or Spotify not answering. Smoother opening (0.13.0): one island shape whose size and corners spring between closed, notice and open states; open content laid out at full size and revealed by the growing shape with a short fade, so nothing reflows; Reduce Motion keeps instant changes. Grows out of a solid notch: the closed shape is solid black just inside the camera housing, open content scales out from the top (and back in on close), and everything is masked to the island outline; header spacing tightened. Opening bursts out of the notch (content from 30% scale and blurred, slight spring overshoot); closing pulls back quickly without bounce. Ringing-call wings: bouncing green phone and the caller's first name or "Call".

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Generic drag lifecycle: one outgoing drag at a time; every prepared core drag session ended exactly once after drop, cancellation, failed start or mouse release during preparation; shelf held open meanwhile; failures reported without contents.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. AppKit NSDraggingSource overlay for shelf tiles: click selects, drag prepares core exports then starts a native copy-only drag with a file URL and in-memory PNG data per item; ends the flow when AppKit ends the session.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Platform adapter: Spotify's PlaybackStateChanged distributed notification and Spotify launch/quit only; Apple Events only to com.spotify.client using its own dictionary codes (playpause/next/previous, player state/position, current track id/name/artist/album/duration), 2-second timeouts on a background queue, AEDeterminePermissionToAutomateTarget for the Automation prompt; never launches Spotify. Permission is requested for the specific core/getd event, because wildcard codes never show the Automation prompt. Permission is now probed with a real player-state read: never-interact to check quietly, a normal send with a long timeout to show the Automation dialog. AEDeterminePermissionToAutomateTarget was removed after it blocked indefinitely on the user's Mac. Every call runs under a hard deadline. Seek via core/setd of the writable player position; 700 ms settle before confirming a command. 0.7.1: artwork lookup (track ID and artwork URL via Apple Events under the same deadline) and an ephemeral, cookie-free, cache-free, redirect-refusing download from the validated image host, limited to 2 MB and image MIME types. 0.11.0: only "would require consent" maps to needs-permission; timeouts and other failures map to no answer. Logs only result codes of permission checks and Apple Events (no track or account details) for diagnosis.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Artwork URL validation (https on i.scdn.co only, no credentials or other ports, bounded length), accepted image types, and the injected-environment SpotifyArtworkLoader: one lookup per track with a single retry when Spotify still reports the previous track, generation-guarded so a slow earlier cover never replaces the current one, size-bounded, memory only, cleared on stop.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. In-memory now-playing model, Spotify notification/scripting parsing (duration in milliseconds, position in seconds, bounded control-free text), extrapolated position, and the injected-environment SpotifyController lifecycle (start/stop observation, generation-guarded replies, permission states, commands). Deadline helper: blocking platform work on its own thread with a fallback at the deadline; late results are discarded exactly once. Only one permission request is in flight at a time; stop clears it. Seek command (clamped to the track); optimistic play/pause and seek shown before sending; confirmation after a settle delay and only for the latest command; unexpected send failures re-read the real state. 0.11.0: a failed or timed-out permission check is reported as "didn't answer" rather than missing permission, and a stuck needs-permission or denied state is re-checked quietly (never prompting) on Spotify updates at most every 10 seconds. Previous past 3 seconds shows the restart at once (Spotify restarts rather than going back); nearer the start it waits for the new track.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Counter and reading model: CPU from tick differences, per-second network and disk rates from two samples (no rate for the first sample, a zero interval or counters that went backwards), validated memory, GPU and storage values, text formatting, and the injected-environment StatsController that samples only between start and stop, keeps a minute of history and forgets everything on stop.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Read-only sampling from public interfaces: host_statistics CPU ticks, host_statistics64 memory (app, wired, compressed), NET_RT_IFLIST2 64-bit interface byte counters excluding loopback, IOBlockStorageDriver and IOAccelerator statistics, and startup-volume capacity cached for 30 seconds. No process list, permission, storage or network use.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. AirDrop progress model: only AirDrop's receiving operation is followed, bounded control-character-free names, smoothed speed, size and time-left text; and the injected-environment TransferController with one subscription, coalesced UI updates, only an actual cancel counted as stopped, at most ten recent items kept 30 minutes, cancel forwarded only for cancellable transfers, and stop that unsubscribes, forgets the list and ignores late events. Browser downloads were dropped by the owner after a first build mislabelled a finished download.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Subscribes with Progress.addSubscriber(forFileURL:) to the Downloads folder (never listed or read) and follows only AirDrop's receiving progress, reads file URL and operation kind from the published progress, observes byte counts by KVO delivered on the main thread, reports the final numbers before the end, forwards Cancel to AirDrop, and reveals received files in Finder on request. The folder is injectable for scratch checks.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. CaptureTarget enum and pure frontmost-window hit-testing over parsed CGWindowListCopyWindowInfo entries (layer 0, other processes, visible, minimum size); malformed entries skipped.

Dependency-free storage/export ownership core, shared unchanged by the Swift package and app framework target. File operations take the export record and use its validated stored name.

Dependency-free storage/export ownership core, shared unchanged by the Swift package and app framework target. New exports named from the item's capture time in an injectable time zone, numbered for same-second captures, falling back to the identifier name if unrepresentable.
